clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers find food, drink, and shelter with Innkeeper Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill.

Innkeeper Renee welcomes weary newcomers to the Gallows' End Tavern, Brill's central inn. She sells food, drink, and general goods from behind her counter, and remarks that the Forsaken have huge appetites. Her tavern offers the undead of Tirisfal a cozy place to rest as plague victims make their way in the world.

Newcomers to Brill often stop first at Renee's inn. Calvin Montague of Deathknell sends fresh adventurers to her with a nondescript letter, the word she has eagerly awaited. Beneath the tavern's floorboards, the cellar also holds a captured Scarlet Crusade zealot.
